findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-escalation.ts:523: formatReviewEscalationFailure still opens with "first REVIEW round recorded multiple countable reviewer problems" even when the new explicitHighRiskPolicy path is the sole trigger and countableProblems is 0. WHY: B-963c adds explicitlyConfiguredHighRiskPolicyRequires3x2 as an independent DONE escalation trigger, so a policy-only block now produces a false root-cause message; operators following the failure text may chase reviewer findings that do not exist. Severity: medium.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed policy-only failure copy in formatReviewEscalationFailure so explicitHighRiskPolicy-only blocks name explicitlyConfiguredHighRiskPolicyRequires3x2 instead of first-review findings. Added smoke check policy-only escalation failure text names explicit high-risk policy. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.js (11 checks); node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; node packages/main/dist/cli.js gap_analyze; node packages/main/dist/cli.js convergence_check.
